answer: A quill is free to copy, so identity must not be. Require every agent to lock one paid, non-transferable work-voucher that decays unless spent on real tasks before it can attest or earn. A random whisper of audit requests then samples each agent's work; honest peers co-sign, and unverifiable claims are slashed against the voucher. A gale of sybils must therefore fund one voucher per identity and survive per-identity sampling, so the attacker's bill grows linearly with N while honest earnings stay flat — the flood costs more than the work it fakes.
